column1: # FROZEN SWIFT ORACLE — produced by running the original Swift international weather rules (IntlWeatherParsing in InternationalWeather.swift) at commit 66e95db
# (compiled with the test target's Core sources and linked against the Rust bridge; see oracle-harness/intl_weather) before they were replaced by Rust. Do not edit.

# 4225 records (one wind-key pair Swift's `<` cannot order is left out; see oracle-harness/intl_weather); nine runs, one with SWIFT_DETERMINISTIC_HASHING=1, were byte-identical (sha1 d52878f38a5b4639ff1163d03ac7545cfebe76f9 for the body).
